title: The first Loose ends run finds a read hotel confirmation's free-cancellation deadline in the backfill

messages.subject: Booking confirmed: Harbour Hotel, 3-5 April
messages.body:
Dear Sam,

Thank you for your booking 48213 at Harbour Hotel.
Check-in: Friday 3 April 2026 from 15:00
Check-out: Sunday 5 April 2026 by 11:00
Room: double room with breakfast, 2 nights, 236.00 EUR, payable at the hotel.

Free cancellation until 1 April 2026. After that date the first night is charged.

We look forward to welcoming you.
Harbour Hotel reservations
